name: aether-sdk
description: Aether SDK — Multi-platform behavioral analytics and Web3 data collection

scripts.build: VITE_AETHER_ENV=production VITE_KYBER_ENV=production VITE_DEMO_ENV=production VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.invalid VITE_AETHER_ENDPOINT=https://api.invalid VITE_WS_BASE_URL=wss://api.invalid VITE_GRAPHQL_URL=https://api.invalid/v1/analytics/graphql VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY=https://identity.invalid VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=workspace-build VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI=https://app.invalid/callback VITE_DEMO_TENANT_ID=certification-demo VITE_DEMO_SEED_NAMESPACE=certification VITE_AETHER_URL=https://app.invalid VITE_KYBER_URL=https://operator.invalid npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/sdk/web/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace=@olympus/brand --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aether/config --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/ui/core --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/aether-web --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/kyber-web --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/demo --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/marketing-olympus --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/marketing-aether --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/sdk/react-native --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/sdk/mobile-core --if-present
scripts.deps:unused: npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 packages/sdk/web && npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 packages/sdk/react-native && npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 apps/kyber-web
scripts.security:deps: npm audit --omit=dev || true; (command -v pip-audit >/dev/null && pip-audit || echo 'pip-audit not installed (optional)')
scripts.security:vuln: echo 'Run a container/image scanner (e.g. trivy) against built images; see docs/operations/VULNERABILITY-MANAGEMENT.md'
scripts.security:sbom: npx --yes @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@^1 --output-file sbom.json || echo 'SBOM tool unavailable; see docs/operations/DEPENDENCY-AUDIT.md'
scripts.security:licenses: npx --yes license-checker@^25 --summary || echo 'license-checker unavailable; see docs/operations/DEPENDENCY-AUDIT.md'
scripts.security:audit: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:deps
scripts.load:smoke: python tests/load/generate_synthetic.py --tenants 3 --events 100 >/dev/null && echo 'load smoke ok (synthetic generation)'
scripts.load:ingestion: if command -v locust >/dev/null 2>&1; then locust -f tests/load/locustfile.py --host ${AETHER_HOST:-http://localhost:8000}; else echo 'locust not installed; see docs/operations/LOAD-TESTING.md'; fi
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test --workspace=apps/aether-web && npm run test --workspace=apps/kyber-web && npm run test:component --workspace=apps/kyber-web && npm run test:integration --workspace=apps/kyber-web && npm run test --workspace=apps/demo && npm run test --workspace=apps/marketing-olympus && npm run test --workspace=apps/marketing-aether
scripts.test:security: npm run security:secrets && python -m pytest tests/unit/test_p4_security_billing.py -q
scripts.proof:all: npm run proof:tenant:reset && npm run proof:platforms:register && npm run proof:sdk-keys:generate && npm run proof:fixtures:load && npm run proof:platform-status:verify
scripts.smoke:all: npm run smoke:staging && npm run smoke:web-sdk && npm run smoke:ios-sdk && npm run smoke:android-sdk && npm run smoke:stripe-connector && npm run smoke:shopify-connector && npm run smoke:email-connector
